review_type: Adversarial self-review of existing endpoints, additional controls, source photographs and exact dictionary senses. External Claude review did not execute.

decisions.issue: Prior A priority was defined by frequency and chosen role
decisions.action: Replace confidence-like grades with explicit semantic shortlist, structural role, pictorial, weakened lexical and conflict decisions

decisions.issue: Hundreds of codes and three positions allow selection of favourable tests
decisions.action: BH across 1788 position tests plus a common maximum-standardized-statistic permutation diagnostic

decisions.issue: Medial W142 looks favourable before stricter multiplicity adjustment
decisions.action: Keep staff-bearing picture; report maximum-statistic p = 0.478 and leave administrative office open

decisions.issue: W154/W156 and W158 could be pooled by pictorial resemblance
decisions.action: Shortlist W154/W156 together as a candidate family; separate W158 because of its differing distribution

decisions.issue: Earlier exact-headword statistics still normalized the inferred residual
decisions.action: Add literal exact residual matching with separately labelled normalized results; downgrade ati, sam and sa

decisions.issue: Word-ending productivity creates many apparent Sanskrit matches
decisions.action: Enumerate rival residuals and compare alternative anchor words and 1000 same-length dictionary stems

decisions.issue: W204 conflicts with the blind second coder’s Bonta SENA crosswalk
decisions.action: Expose first W373 versus second W204 and withdraw a selected share-product reading

decisions.issue: Carrier and farm-labour interpretations could be presented as new discoveries
decisions.action: Credit Rao 2018 and distinguish new code-level diagnostics/anchors from prior pictorial interpretations

decisions.issue: M-81 segmentation changes the number of tokens
decisions.action: Keep paired-compartment meaning conditional; display the two-grid schematic and the two-sign alternative

decisions.issue: Dictionary homonyms and compound forms can give an incorrect anchor
decisions.action: Choose exact sense IDs, use bhārin rather than load/weight bhāraka, carman rather than the shield homonym of carma, and replace placeholder citations

decisions.issue: A guessed M-81 record ID and unlicensed font could mislead the public viewer
decisions.action: Validate every selected example against the local input, correct to Lipi 2608.1, use attributed CC BY class cells and an authored W617 schematic
Record the CLI authentication failure and skip without substituting a model
